map.强密码检测器（检查强度） 使用指南: Strong Password Detector (Check Strength) User Guide
map.实时检测所输入密码的强度，分析长度、大小写、数字、符号组合并给出 0–100 安: Analyzes the strength of the entered password in real time, covering length, upper/lowercase, digits and symbol mix, and gives a 0–100 security score with a grade, helping you set stronger account passwords and avoid weak ones.
map.注册或改密前自检口令，避免「四类字符但含常见词」的伪强密码。: Check your own password before registering or changing it, to avoid the pseudo-strong password with all four character classes but a common word.
map.：`Password1!` 含四类但常见词 → 中；`Tq7!mK9@pL2#`: : `Password1!` has all four classes but a common word → medium; `Tq7!mK9@pL2#` → strong (high entropy).
map.强度看什么？: What does the strength depend on?
map.长度、字符集、是否词典词。: Length, character set, whether it is a dictionary word.
map.不是。页面按长度与字符多样性估算，不含泄露库比对；判为「强」仍建议避免常见词与个: No. The page estimates from length and character diversity only, without breached-database comparison; even a "strong" rating should still avoid common words and personal information.
